ar1-l1.text: Not long after that, the good old man dreamed again,

ar1-l2.text: Take the ashes of the mill, sprinkle them on the withered trees, and they will bloom again.

tut-1.text: Look at the pendulum bob swinging back and forth.

tut-2.text: You can see the metallic ball repeating this...

tut-3.text: An oscillation is complete when the bob starts at its middle position, swings to one side, goes to the other side, and returns back to the middle.

tut-4.text: When we increase the string length to one point five meters, the time period gets longer.

leader.text: Get down on your knees! Get down on your knees!

imagine.text: Imagine if the old man climbed down to kneel quietly...

q2.text: Dog-Spirit, why did you help the old man?

dog-a.text: I helped him because he was always so kind and loving to me, and I wanted to bring joy back to his sweet heart.
